definitions.explanation: Life as the opposite of death: the state of being alive, or one's existence in this world. A written, rather formal word; everyday speech uses other words (see the notes).

examples.japanese: ⟦この{世|よ}→この世：10334_konoyo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生|せい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: To be born into this world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚悟|かくご}→覚悟：02551_kakugo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧とき、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧{生|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Facing death on the battlefield, he thought about the meaning of life for the first time.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {生|せい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧: life and death
- {生|せい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be born
- {生|せい}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{執着|しゅうちゃく}→執着：05950_shuuchaku⟧: clinging to life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧: life as something one has and can lose; the everyday word
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧: one's life as lived, from birth to death

WATCH OUT:
- The kanji also reads なま (raw), and 〜{生|せい} after a number or school level means a student (⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧)
